name: Abhishek Bulk Metadata Editor for Rank Math
author: abhisheksoni8299

sections.description:
Abhishek Bulk Metadata Editor for Rank Math lets administrators validate a list of page URLs, SEO titles, and meta descriptions before updating selected pages.

The plugin writes only the rank_math_title and rank_math_description post meta fields. It integrates with Rank Math metadata but is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rank Math.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/abhishek-bulk-metadata-editor-for-rank-math/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Abhishek Bulk Metadata Editor for Rank Math from the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Which metadata does this plugin update?

The plugin updates the rank_math_title and rank_math_description post meta fields for selected pages.

Who can use the bulk editor?

Only users with the manage_options capability can access and submit the bulk editor.
